THE FAUNA AND FLORA PROTECTION ORDINANCE (CHAPTER 469)
Order under Subsection (2) of Section 2

BY virtue of the powers vested in me subsection (2) of section 2 of the Fauna and Flora Protection Ordinance (Chapter 469),I, John Anthony Emmanuel Amaratunga, Minister of Tourism Development, Wildlife and Christian Religious Affairs, do bythis Order declare the area of land described in the Schedule hereto to be a Sanctuary for the purposes of the aforesaidOrdinance and further declare that such sanctuary shall be known as the “Great Basses and Little Basses Marine Sanctuary”.
JOHN ANTHONY EMMANUEL AMARATUNGA,
Minister of Tourism Development,Wildlife and Christian Religious Affairs.Colombo,
SCHEDULE
LIMITS OF THE AREA OF LAND COMPRISING THE GREAT BASSES AND LITTLE BASSES MARINE SANTUARY

All that area of land containing in extent 67282.3 hectares siuatd within the Tissamaharama Divisional Secretary’sDivision in the Administrative District of Hambantota in the Southern Province and bounded by the GPS Coordinatesobtained from the SLD 99 coordinate system in accordance with the map ratio 1 : 50,000 of the Surveyor Department asfollows :
